summary: Iteration 67: All four items verified across web + mobile + shared backend. WEB Light/System/Dark theme picker works (menu opens, options set html.dark, persist to localStorage 'smn-theme', survive reload, and System live-follows emulated OS scheme). Orange (#F2A03B) CTAs render with dark ink text rgb(16,35,58) = #10233A in BOTH light AND dark modes (contrast ~7.2:1 vs orange, WCAG AAA). MOBILE market memory: selecting 'Greater Seattle' on Hub is remembered as active chip on Events (market-chip-Greater Seattle, bg rgb(31,63,91)) and Crew Bank (crew-market-Greater Seattle), and persists across reload; localStorage 'smn-market-pref' updates. MOBILE 'My markets' selectable via market-opt-mine; Hub button label becomes 'My markets'. Profile has 'MARKETS YOU FOLLOW' row with edit-markets-row -> modal with 10 follow-market-<name> checkboxes + save-markets-btn; PATCH /api/auth/markets returned updated markets and kept primary_market='Greater Seattle' when Bellingham was added (revert clean). Backend: 7/7 pytest passes covering markets CSV filter on /posts /events /discussions /crew-bank/open /crew-bank/standalone, PATCH /auth/markets keeping primary, and RSVP (POST /events/{id}/register kind=attendee) creating an 'event_rsvp' notification for the organizer. Mobile Appearance section still present with testIDs theme-light/system/dark (regression clean). Dark-mode readability intact (body rgb(11,18,32), h1 white).

parity_issues.issue: Header ThemeToggle renders with data-testid='theme-toggle' (component default) instead of the spec's 'theme-toggle-btn'. Not blocking (menu + options 'theme-opt-light/system/dark' work), but review-request selector doesn't match.
parity_issues.actual: data-testid='theme-toggle' (default testId prop in /app/frontend/src/components/ThemeToggle.jsx L15). Header should pass testId='theme-toggle-btn' when mounting it.

action_items: OPTIONAL: pass testId='theme-toggle-btn' to <ThemeToggle /> in the web header so it matches the spec (mobile uses theme-light/system/dark IDs which already match the mobile spec).
critical_code_review_comments: marketPref.ts default is 'mine' via module-level `let _v: MarketPref = "mine"`; storage seed is best-effort (silent catch). Fine for MVP but note first paint after cold reload can briefly show 'mine' before AsyncStorage hydrates a saved value — didn't visibly flicker in testing but worth remembering.

community_router.py L613-623: RSVP-organizer notify wrapped in try/except that only swallows exceptions; verified the happy path works. `notify()` is not awaited for self-RSVP (org_id==user_id early return), which correctly avoids self-notify.
ThemeContext.jsx correctly guards `window` in initialPref/systemScheme for SSR safety and adds an mql listener with cleanup. Meta theme-color updates on transition. LGTM.
test_credentials: Minted seed_marina token test_session_mobile_1789103018713 for mobile localStorage seeding. Backend pytest mints per-test tokens via mongosh (captain.jane, crew.alex, pro.marina).
seed_data_creation: One TEST_RSVP_* event created and left behind by pytest (organizer captain.jane). Bellingham was temporarily added to seed_marina.markets then reverted; final state matches iteration_66 baseline (Greater Seattle, Kirkland, Everett).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Everything for iter67 features passes. Reusable regression test: /app/backend/tests/test_iter67_markets_notifs.py (7 tests). For mobile UI: seed 'session_token' JSON-encoded into localStorage before nav, use 428x920 viewport, wait ~5s per screen for AuthContext + AsyncStorage hydration. Note: RSVP endpoint is POST /api/events/{id}/register with body {kind:'attendee'|'volunteer'} (NOT /rsvp). Web theme trigger currently uses testID 'theme-toggle' (not 'theme-toggle-btn' as request wrote).
rca of the issue: N/A - no bugs found. Only note: initial pytest failure on RSVP was tester-side (used wrong endpoint /rsvp and wrong response shape assumption). Fixed to POST /events/{id}/register and handled notifications response shape {items,unread}. Retest passed.
